Subject: gas release at Compressor Station 4

Just rolled up to Station 4 around 1530 for the quarterly valve grease job. At 1538 I caught a sweet gas smell near the suction scrubber skid. Walked the lines, found the 3-inch vent on the scrubber discharge was open. Valve was tagged "closed" but the handle was about 1/4 turn off seat. No flowmeter on the vent so no number on volume.

Tag says it was shut after the last filter change on May 17, but the maintenance sheet shows it as "closed & verified." Both documents are in the shack—one says one thing, one says another. Compressor was running the whole time, no trip. Secured the valve and called it in. Site’s stable now.

- L. Chen, Field Op

Subject: leak at Regina compressor station

Just had the AM rounds guy call in – says he smelled crude around the east yard valve bank about 08:00. Walked the lines and found oil weeping past the packing on the main 12" ball valve (tag K-4). Still contained on station property, nothing outside the fence. Log shows the valve was repacked under work order W-114 last week, but looks like it didn’t hold. He grabbed a bucket and rags, estimated maybe 1.2 m³ total, all sweet crude. Called me, I told him to shut down the valve upstream and put absorbents down. Maintenance is rolling a crew now. That’s all I got. Let me know if you need more.

Dave
Control Room Op
Redwillow Gas Systems Inc.
